title: Virgin Mary image? How Catholic church verifies apparitions
excerpt: Fr Leo Mwenda Itabari says before the Church pronounces itself officially on a miracle or apparition, it takes time.
content:
• Article
  • Related

Kisii County was abuzz with whispers of miracles days ago. Crowds gathered at what some claimed was the image of the Virgin Mary, shimmering on a mud-walled house in Bobasi.

Videos went viral, sparking excitement, speculation and devotion. Amid the euphoria, the Catholic Church urged caution.
